sources.title: Joint competing-event reward covariance and sharp sequential coupling envelope
sources.author: Causal banking proposal
sources.source_identity: Project-authored finite history law and conditional kernel/reward proof

local_copy.anchor: Exact vector moments and coupling witness

inspected_anchors: Whole-subject two-period event vector mean and covariance follow both nine-path enumeration and separate indicator identities.
The monetary variance is c^T Sigma c; dropping covariance overstates variance in the constructed law and has no universal direction.
For equal starting laws, a fixed common policy/reward and uniform transition TV budgets, first-split recursion gives q=1-product(1-epsilon).
A two-state absorbing-divergence witness attains the running plus terminal envelope jointly; tighter and additive totals are60 and61.2USD for stipulated budgets.
